description: Wait for a duration, text, snapshot ref, selector to appear, selector to be strictly absent, or stable UI. Text matches a label, identifier, or value; an editable field never matches by its current value or by a label that only repeats it, so text you typed does not satisfy it. Use the strict absence target when zero selector matches are required; stable waits until the UI stays quiet for the requested window. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: wait
